source_coverage.equation_scope: Relationships among literal values only. Missing fields are not treated as zero; no tax basis, unit, quantity or final-total fact is filled from arithmetic.

limits: Source-informed assistant audit and retained-reading diagnostics on familiar original evaluation images. No new blind cohort, inference latency, grouped-price score, full financial truth or complete-receipt accuracy. No scanner tuning on these held-out diagnostics; fresh evaluation data is required for later tuning claims.
